newsitem.title: UK: S&P affirms Canandaigua Wine,cuts outlook.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms Canandaigua Wine,cuts outlook.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Tuesday it revised its outlook on Canandaigua Wine Co. Inc. to negative from stable after news the company expects a significant fiscal 1997 profit decline.
S&P said it affirmed its B plus rating on the company's senior subordinated notes. The corporate credit rating is BB.
